Diego (Sales): Quick ask — Nimbus Systems wants a 3-month handshake pilot at $45k (list $60k). Asking for 25% off + Net45 and a bespoke data-sharing clause. They want Redwood to whitelist IP ranges and do a weekly sync. Need to confirm custom legal and payment term exception. Quote: https://redwood.app/quotes/QL-5011 @Nell (Finance) @Hannah (RevOps)
Nell (Finance): Data-sharing clause needs Legal review — potentially PII risk. Net45 can be agreed if finance gets a signed PO and we add a late-payment penalty. 25% is at the limit of standard concessions. What's the ARR motion?
Diego (Sales): They are an infra platform partner; expected ARR $250k if we co-sell. Whitelist request is limited to agent IP ranges and logged access only.
Hannah (RevOps): Procedurally, whitelist/data access requires security review + Legal sign-off. I can log the discount exception up to 20% without escalations. For 25% need Sales head and Finance head approval and an SFDC exception.
Rishi (Head of Sales): I approve up to 25% for strategic partner pilots if Legal okays data access and Security signs off. Require a 9-month conversion clause and a signed LOI. Also add a clause: engineering support included (2 days) for onboarding only.
legal-bot: Security intake created: https://security.redwood.app/req/SEC-7745. Data access request flagged for DLP review.
Nell (Finance): I'll prepare the accounting notes and require the contract to include `invoice adjustment clause` for onboarding discounts and `clawback if no conversion in 9 months`. Also prefer Net30 unless PO + credit check cleared.
Diego (Sales): Customer insists on Net45. I'll push for PO and exec LOI now. If we can't get PO quickly, we'll accept Net30 as fallback.
Hannah (RevOps): I'll create SFDC exception: `partner-pilot-whitelist` and add tasks to attach security intake and legal sign-off.
Rishi (Head of Sales): Approve option: 25% + Net45 conditional on security/Legal + signed LOI + 9-month clawback. Diego, loop in engineering and security threads to get the intake fast.
Diego (Sales): Looping in engineering and the customer. I'll update this thread with final signed attachments. Thanks :raised_hands:
